title: A preference carries over to a new conversation
checks: A standing preference stated in one conversation is followed in the next one.
why: Having to repeat how you like things done in every new chat is the first thing people notice about an assistant without memory.

case.name: A preference carries over to a new conversation
case.about: The preference to {{preference}} still applies in a new conversation.

turns.message: One thing for all our chats from now on: please {{preference}}.

reply.reference: Handles the request and {{effect}}, without being reminded.
